facts.statement: Prove E_r(n)<=C(n,2)-(r-1)(r+4)/2 for m=n-r>=8. This pilot concerns m=8 with 4..8 positive zero blocks. Full m=8 and general m remain open.

Using supplied manuscript comparison and stretching lemmas, a convex rational mixture of verified profiles proves all positive block lengths when weighted base <31+6k and every block coefficient <=6. Integer word lengths turn strict T+1 into <=T. No LP miss proves infeasibility. This is not formal proof-assistant certification.

A fixed 512-source catalog pool closes 14 of the previous 48 unresolved development families. The remaining 34 are the pilot. The seed adjacent-inversion policy closes none. New policies add up to32 words per family to the same fixed baseline; no cumulative changing evaluator archive. Families vary in labels and retained gap mask; success applies to all positive lengths via the lemmas.

EvoX finalist adds four exact all-positive-length family certificates to the fixed512 catalog on the34 remaining development cases; sequential adds two contained in those four. One EvoX strategy rewrite brought no further improvement. No ranking claim. These remain m8 constructions, not a general proof.
